tagline: Comprehensive financial services provider with a community bank approach across the South and Southeast
hero_kpi_rationale: Ratio of 94.99% reflects an exceptionally stable funding base with very high core deposits, a distinctive characteristic of a regionally established bank in the US South. This funding stability is a key competitive advantage in a volatile rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Available Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Total amount of liquidity available after covering immediate needs.
kpis.description: Key measure of capacity to meet withdrawals and short-term obligations.
kpis.signal: Liquidity well above uninsured deposits, sign of financial strength.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets held by the bank.
kpis.description: Indicator of size and scope of banking operations.
kpis.signal: Significant size for a regional bank in the US South.

kpis.name: Loan Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans extended to customers.
kpis.description: Includes commercial, consumer, and small business loans.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of customer deposits held at the bank.
kpis.description: Primary funding source for loans and investments.

kpis.name: Core Deposits Ratio
kpis.description: A high ratio indicates strong customer loyalty. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical values over the past 3 years.

kpis.name: Liquid Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Capacity to cover liabilities with easily convertible assets.
kpis.description: Ratio increasing since 2023, reflecting prudent management.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1.34 billion EUR in latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.7 billion EUR in latest year

kpis.name: Free Securities Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of securities available for sale or use as collateral.
kpis.description: Key indicator of financial flexibility in case of crisis.
kpis.signal: Increased capacity to meet liquidity needs.

kpis.name: Wholesale Funding / Core Deposits Ratio
kpis.explanation: Reliance on external funding relative to local deposits.
kpis.description: Significant decline since 2023, sign of improved self-sufficiency.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has a liquidity ratio of 15.63% as of end-2025, which exceeds the required minimum of 7.5%, but a decline in liquidity could negatively impact the company. (Table 28)

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The loan loss provision ratio is 1.43% as of end-2025, which is considered elevated. (Fourth Quarter 2025)

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulatory requirements regarding capital and liquidity, and non-compliance could have negative consequences. (Table 30)

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market fluctuations, particularly concerning interest rates and asset prices. (Fourth Quarter 2025)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: A reputation crisis could negatively impact the company, particularly regarding customer loss and market share erosion. (No specific mention in text)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity threats, which could have serious consequences for data confidentiality and company reputation. (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: HWC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial aspects and operations without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
